label: prf:categorical-hodge-star-exists
title: Proof of existence of the categorical Hodge star
html: Non-degeneracy of the Frobenius pairing (Frobenius pairing) gives a unique morphism \star \beta \in \Omega^{n-k}(A) for every \beta \in \Omega^k(A) determined by the defining identity \alpha \wedge \star \beta = \int_A(\alpha^* \cdot \beta) \mathrm{vol} for all \alpha \in \Omega^k(A). Involutivity \star^2 = \mathrm{id} follows from S^2 = \mathrm{id} on the commutative Frobenius--Hopf algebra A, extended to \Omega^k(A) via the graded Leibniz rule.
heading: Proof
